entries.13.1: अथ then, तत्र there, केनचित् कालेन after some time, लोकेश्वरोत्सृष्टा sent by the lord of the worlds, रूपिणी taking form, तीव्रा heavy, निद्रा sleep, कुम्भकर्णस्य upon Kumbhakarna, समभवत् came
entries.13.2: ततः then, कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, आसीनम् who was seated, भ्रातरम् to his brother, वचः a word, अब्रवीत् said, राजन् king, निद्रा sleep, माम् me, बाधते oppresses, मम my, आलयम् dwelling, कारयस्व have made
entries.13.3: ततः then, राज्ञा by the king, विनियुक्ताः appointed, विश्वकर्मवत् skilled as Vishvakarma, शिल्पिनः the craftsmen, योजनम् a yojana, विस्तीर्णम् broad, शुभ्रम् bright, ततः and, द्विगुणम् twice as much, आयतम् long
entries.13.4: दर्शनीयम् lovely to behold, निराबाधम् free of disturbance, कुम्भकर्णस्य for Kumbhakarna, चक्रिरे made, स्फाटिकैः of crystal, काञ्चनैः of wrought gold, चित्रैः bright, स्तम्भैः with pillars, सर्वत्र everywhere, शोभितम् adorned
entries.13.5: वैडूर्यकृतसोपानम् with steps of beryl, किङ्किणीजालकम् a network of little bells, तथा and, दान्ततोरणविन्यस्तम् set with archways of ivory, वज्रस्फटिकवेदिकम् with terraces of diamond and crystal
entries.13.6: राक्षसः the rakshasa, मनोहरम् delightful, सर्वसुखम् full of every comfort, सर्वत्र in every part, नित्यम् always, सुखदम् giving ease, मेरोः of Meru, पुण्याम् गुहाम् इव like a holy cave, कारयामास had it made
entries.13.7: तत्र there, महाबलः the mighty, कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, निद्राम् sleep, समाविष्टः overcome by, बहूनि अब्दसहस्राणि for many thousands of years, शयानः lying, न प्रबुद्ध्यते did not wake
entries.13.8: तदा then, कुम्भकर्णे Kumbhakarna, निद्राभिभूते तु being overcome by sleep, दशाननः Dashanana, निरङ्कुशः हि with none to check him, देवर्षियक्षगन्धर्वान् gods and sages and yakshas and gandharvas, सञ्जघ्ने slew
entries.13.9: नन्दनादीनि the Nandana and the rest, चित्राणि beautiful, यानि उद्यानानि च whatever gardens there were, तानि those, गत्वा having gone to, सुसङ्क्रुद्धः in great fury, दशाननः Dashanana, भिनत्ति स्म broke down
entries.13.10: नदीम् in a river, गजः इव as an elephant, क्रीडन् sporting, वृक्षान् trees, वायुः इव as the wind, क्षिपन् tossing, नगान् the mountains, उत्सृष्टः loosed, वज्रः इव as a thunderbolt, राक्षसः the rakshasa, विध्वंसयति laid waste
entries.13.11: तथावृत्तम् तु behaving so, दशग्रीवम् Dashagriva, विज्ञाय having learned, धर्मज्ञः the knower of dharma, धनेश्वरः the lord of wealth, आत्मनः his own, कुलानुरूपम् befitting his family, वृत्तम् conduct, संस्मृत्य च and remembering
entries.13.12: तदा then, वैश्रवणः Vaishravana, सौभ्रात्रदर्शनार्थम् in the spirit of brotherhood, दशग्रीवस्य for Dashagriva, हितम् वै for his good, दूतम् an envoy, लङ्काम् to Lanka, सम्प्रेषयामास sent
entries.13.13: सः he, लङ्काम् नगरीम् the city of Lanka, गत्वा having gone, विभीषणम् Vibhishana, आससाद came to, तेन by him, धर्मेण according to dharma, मानितः honoured, आगमनम् प्रति concerning his coming, पृष्टः च and asked
entries.13.14: विभीषणः Vibhishana, राज्ञः of the king, ज्ञातीनाम् च and of the kinsmen, कुशलम् the welfare, पृष्ट्वा च having asked, सभायाम् in the assembly hall, आसीनम् seated, तम् दशाननम् that Dashanana, दर्शयामास brought him before
entries.13.15: सः he, तत्र there, स्वतेजसा with his own splendour, दीप्यमानम् blazing, राजानम् the king, दृष्ट्वा having seen, जय इति with the word Victory, वाचा with speech, सम्पूज्य having honoured, तूष्णीम् silent, समभिवर्तत stood
entries.13.16: तत्र there, वरास्तरणशोभिते bright with excellent coverings, उत्तमपर्यङ्के upon a fine couch, उपविष्टम् seated, तम् दशग्रीवम् to that Dashagriva, अथ then, दूतः the envoy, वाक्यम् a word, अब्रवीत् said
entries.13.17: राजन् king, वीर hero, तव your, भ्राता brother, यत् अब्रवीत् what has said, ते to you, सर्वम् all, वदामि I shall tell, उभयोः of both, वृत्तस्य of your conduct, कुलस्य च and of your family, सदृशम् worthy
entries.13.18: साधु enough, एतावत् this much, पर्याप्तम् is sufficient, चारित्रसङ्ग्रहः a gathering of a name for deeds, कृतः has been made, साधु it is well, धर्मे in dharma, व्यवस्थानम् standing firm, शक्यते यदि if it can be done, क्रियताम् let it be done
entries.13.19: मे by me, नन्दनम् the Nandana grove, भग्नम् broken, दृष्टम् has been seen, ऋषयः the sages, निहताः slain, श्रुताः have been heard of, राजन् king, त्वत्तः against you, देवतानाम् of the gods, समुद्योगः the preparation, मम by me, श्रुतः has been heard
entries.13.20: राक्षसाधिप lord of rakshasas, अहम् I, त्वया by you, बहुशः many times, निराकृतः च have been slighted, स्वबान्धवाः one's own kinsmen, रमणीयाः हि are dear indeed, बाल्यात् च out of childishness, अपराद्धाः they offend
entries.13.21: अहम् तु for my part, धर्मम् dharma, उपासितुम् to serve, हिमवत्पृष्ठम् to the slopes of Himavat, गतः went, रौद्रम् fierce, व्रतम् an observance, समास्थाय having taken up, नियतः restrained, नियतेन्द्रियः with senses controlled
entries.13.22: तत्र there, मया by me, प्रभुः the lord, देवः the god, देव्या सह with his consort, दृष्टः was seen, तत्र there, दैवात् by chance, मया my, सव्यम् चक्षुः left eye, देव्याम् upon the goddess, निपातितम् fell
entries.13.23: शुभा auspicious, इयम् this one, का नु who may be, स्यात् इति thus I thought, अन्येन हेतुना for another reason, न खलु not at all, अनुपमम् beyond compare, रूपम् a beauty, कृत्वा हि having taken on, रुद्राणी Rudrani, तत्र there, तिष्ठति stood
entries.13.24: देव्याः of the goddess, दिव्यप्रभावेण by her divine power, मम my, सव्यम् left, ईक्षणम् eye, दग्धम् was burnt, रेणुध्वस्तम् choked with dust, ज्योतिः इव as a lamp, पिङ्गलत्वम् tawniness, उपागतम् came to
entries.13.25: ततः then, अहम् I, तस्य गिरेः of that mountain, अन्यत् another, विस्तीर्णम् broad, तटम् slope, गत्वा having gone to, अष्टौ वर्षशतानि for eight hundred years, तूष्णीम् in silence, महाव्रतम् a great vow, समाधारम् held
entries.13.26: तस्मिन् नियमे that observance, समाप्ते being complete, तत्र there, प्रभुः the lord, देवः the god, महेश्वरः Maheshvara, प्रीतः pleased, प्रीतेन with a pleased, मनसा heart, इदम् वाक्यम् these words, प्राह spoke
entries.13.27: देव्याः of the goddess, रूपनिरीक्षणात् from looking on the form, यत् पैङ्गल्यम् what tawniness, अवाप्तम् हि was obtained, धर्मज्ञ knower of dharma, सुव्रत holder of good vows, अनेन तपसा for this penance, तव with you, प्रीतः अस्मि I am pleased
entries.13.28: धनाधिप lord of wealth, एतत् व्रतम् this vow, मया by me, त्वया च एव and by you alone, चीर्णम् has been kept, यः who, ईदृशम् such, व्रतम् a vow, चरेत् would keep, तृतीयः a third, पुरुषः man, न अस्ति there is not
entries.13.29: एतत् this, सुनिश्चयम् of firm resolve, व्रतम् हि is a vow indeed, मया by me, पुरा of old, उत्पादितम् was brought forth, सौम्य gentle one, धनेश्वर lord of wealth, मया with me, तत् सखित्वम् that friendship, रोचयस्व take pleasure in
entries.13.30: अनघ sinless one, तपसा by penance, निर्जितः च conquered, मम my, सखा friend, भव be, देव्याः of the goddess, प्रभावेण by the power, यत् तव सव्यम् your left, ईक्षणम् च and eye, दग्धम् was burnt
entries.13.31: एकाक्षिपिङ्गला इति एव the name One tawny eyed, नाम a name, शाश्वतम् for ever, स्थास्यति shall remain, एवम् thus, तेन with him, सखित्वम् च friendship, प्राप्य having gained, शङ्करात् from Shankara, अनुज्ञाम् च and leave
entries.13.32: आगत्य च and having come away, मे by me, तव your, अयम् this, पापविनिश्चयः evil resolve, श्रुतः was heard
entries.13.33: तत् therefore, कुलदूषणात् which is the ruin of your family, अधर्मिष्ठसंयोगात् from this consorting with unrighteousness, निवर्त turn back, सर्षिसङ्घैः with the hosts of sages, सुरैः by the gods, तव your, वधोपायः the means of death, चिन्त्यते हि is being considered
entries.13.34: एवम् thus, उक्तः being addressed, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva, क्रुद्धसंरक्तलोचनः his eyes red with anger, हस्तौ his hands, दन्तान् च and his teeth, सम्पीड्य grinding together, एतत् वाक्यम् these words, उवाच ह said
entries.13.35: दूत envoy, यस्य of which, प्रभाषसे you speak, वाक्यम् the word, मया by me, ते your, विज्ञातम् has been understood, एतत् this, त्वम् you, न असि are not, असौ he, न एव nor is, येन by whom, भ्रात्रा as a brother, असि चोदितः you were sent
entries.13.36: एषः धनरक्षकः this keeper of riches, मम for me, हितम् for my good, न ब्रवीति does not speak, एतत् हि this indeed, महेश्वरसखित्वम् तु as for the friendship with Maheshvara, मूढ the fool, किल indeed, श्रावयते would have heard
entries.13.37: यत् एतत् this which, त्वया by you, भाषितम् has been spoken, इदम् this, मे to me, न च क्षमणीयम् is not to be pardoned, दूत envoy, यत् that, एतावन्तम् कालम् all this while, मया by me, तस्य for his sake, मर्षितम् तु has been borne
entries.13.38: अयम् he, गुरुः an elder, ज्येष्ठः my superior, मया by me, न हन्तव्यः must not be killed, इति thus, मन्यते I have thought, इदानीम् तु but now, तस्य his, वाक्यम् word, श्रुत्वा having heard, मे my, एषा मतिः this resolve, कृता has been made
entries.13.39: बाहुवीर्यम् the strength of my arms, उपाश्रितः leaning upon, त्रीन् लोकान् अपि the three worlds as well, जेष्यामि I shall conquer
entries.13.40: तस्य एकस्य of that one, कृते for the sake, वै indeed, अहम् I, एतत् मुहूर्तम् एव this very hour, तान् चतुरः लोकपालान् those four guardians of the world, यमक्षयम् to the house of Yama, नयिष्यामि shall send
entries.13.41: एवम् thus, उक्त्वा तु having spoken, लङ्केशः the lord of Lanka, दूतम् the envoy, खड्गेन with his sword, जघ्निवान् struck down, एनम् him, दुरात्मनाम् evil souled, राक्षसानाम् to the rakshasas, भक्षयितुम् हि to devour, ददौ gave
entries.13.42: एवम् thus, कृतस्वस्त्ययनः having performed the rites for a safe journey, रावणः Ravana, रथम् his chariot, आरुह्य having mounted, त्रैलोक्यविजयाकाङ्क्षी longing to conquer the three worlds, धनेश्वरः the lord of wealth, यत्र where, ययौ went
entries.14.1: ततः तु then, नित्यम् ever, बलोद्धतैः swollen with strength, षड्भिः with six, सचिवैः सार्धम् together with ministers, महोदरप्रहस्ताभ्याम् with Mahodara and Prahasta, मारीचशुकसारणैः with Maricha and Shuka and Sarana
entries.14.2: नित्यम् ever, समरगृध्नुना greedy for battle, वीरेण by the hero, धूम्राक्षेण च and by Dhumraksha, वृतः surrounded, श्रीमान् the glorious one, क्रोधात् in anger, लोकान् the worlds, दहन् इव as though burning up, संप्रययौ set out
entries.14.3: सः he, पुराणि cities, नदीः rivers, शैलान् mountains, वनानि forests, उपवनानि च and groves, अतिक्रम्य having passed over, मुहूर्तेन in a moment, कैलासम् गिरिम् the mountain Kailasa, आगमत् reached
entries.14.4: तस्मिन् गिरौ upon that mountain, सन्निविष्टम् settled, युद्धे for battle, अत्यर्थकृतोत्साहम् exceedingly eager, समन्त्रिणम् with his counsellors, दुरात्मानम् that evil souled one, राक्षसेन्द्रम् the lord of rakshasas, निशम्य तु having learned of
entries.14.5: यक्षाः the yakshas, तस्य रक्षसः of that rakshasa, प्रमुखे before, संस्थातुम् to stand, न शेकुः were not able, राज्ञः of the king, भ्राता the brother, इति thus, विज्ञाय knowing, धनेश्वरः the lord of wealth, यत्र where, गताः went
entries.14.6: ते they, गत्वा having gone, तस्य भ्रातुः of that brother, चिकीर्षितम् the intention, सर्वम् all, आचख्युः told, धनदेन by the giver of wealth, अनुज्ञाताः being given leave, हृष्टाः gladly, युद्धाय to battle, ययुः went
entries.14.7: ततः then, बलानाम् of the armies, सङ्क्षोभः the tumult, महोदधेः of the great ocean, तस्य नैर्ऋतराजस्य of that king of the nairritas, शैलम् the mountain, सञ्चालयन् इव as though shaking, व्यवर्धत swelled
entries.14.8: ततः then, यक्षराक्षससङ्कुलम् thick with yakshas and rakshasas, युद्धम् a battle, समभवत् arose, तत्र there, राक्षसस्य of the rakshasa, ते सचिवाः those ministers, व्यथिताः च sorely pressed, अभवन् were
entries.14.9: सः दशग्रीवः that Dashagriva, निशाचरः the night ranger, तादृशम् in such a state, सैन्यम् his force, दृष्ट्वा having seen, बहून् many, हर्षनादान् shouts of joy, कृत्वा having uttered, सः he, क्रोधात् in fury, अभ्यधावत rushed forward
entries.14.10: ये तु those who, राक्षसेन्द्रस्य of the lord of rakshasas, घोरविक्रमाः of dreadful valour, सचिवाः the ministers, तेषाम् of them, एकैकम् each one, यक्षाणाम् of yakshas, सहस्रम् a thousand, समयोधयन् fought
entries.14.11: ततः then, गदाभिः with maces, मुसलैः with pestles, असिभिः with swords, शक्तितोमरैः with spears and javelins, हन्यमानः being struck, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva, तत् सैन्यम् that army, समगाहत plunged into
entries.14.12: सः दशाननः that Dashanana, तत्र there, वध्यमानः being struck, निरुच्छ्वासवत् until he could scarcely breathe, वर्षद्भिः pouring down, धाराभिः with torrents, जीमूतैः इव as by clouds, अवरुध्यत was hemmed in
entries.14.13: यक्षशस्त्रैः by the weapons of the yakshas, समाहतः though struck, अम्भोदैः by clouds, धाराशतसमुक्षितः drenched by a hundred streams, महीधरः इव as a mountain, व्यथाम् pain, न चकार च एव felt none
entries.14.14: सः दुरात्मा that evil souled one, कालदण्डोपमाम् like the staff of Kala, गदाम् his mace, समुद्यम्य having raised, ततः then, यक्षान् the yakshas, यमक्षयम् to Yama's abode, नयन् sending, सैन्यम् the army, प्रविवेश entered
entries.14.15: सः he, विस्तीर्णम् wide, शुष्केन्धनम् with dry fuel, आकुलम् cluttered, कक्षम् इव as a thicket, वातेन by the wind, आयत्तः driven, अग्निः इव as fire, तत् यक्षसैन्यम् that army of yakshas, ददाह burnt
entries.14.16: तत्र there, महोदरशुकादिभिः by Mahodara and Shuka and the rest, तैः महामात्यैः तु by those great ministers, ते यक्षाः those yakshas, वातैः by the winds, अम्बुदाः इव as clouds, अल्पावशेषाः reduced to a remnant, कृताः were made
entries.14.17: केचित् some, समाहताः struck, भग्नाः broken, समरक्षितौ upon the field of battle, पतिताः fell, रणे in the fight, कुपिताः in fury, तीक्ष्णैः दशनैः with sharp teeth, ओष्ठान् च their lips, अदशन् bit
entries.14.18: रणाजिरे upon the field, श्रान्ताः worn out, अन्योन्यम् one another, आलिङ्ग्य च clinging to, भ्रष्टशस्त्राः their weapons fallen, तदा then, यक्षाः the yakshas, जलेन by water, कूलाः इव ह as riverbanks, सीदन्ति sank down
entries.14.19: हतानाम् of the slain, स्वर्गम् to heaven, गच्छताम् going, पृथिवीतले upon the earth, युध्यताम् of those fighting, प्रेक्षताम् of those looking on, ऋषिसङ्घानाम् of the hosts of sages, दिवि in the sky, अन्तरम् space, न बभूव there was none
entries.14.20: भग्नान् broken, तान् महाबलान् those mighty, यक्षेन्द्रान् तु lords of yakshas, समालक्ष्य having seen, महाबाहुः the mighty armed, धनाध्यक्षः lord of wealth, यक्षकान् more yakshas, प्रेषयामास sent out
entries.14.21: राम Rama, एतस्मिन् अन्तरे at that moment, विस्तीर्णबलवाहनः with wide forces and mounts, नाम्ना by name, संयोधकण्टकः Samyodhakantaka, यक्षः a yaksha, प्रेषितः being sent, न्यपतत् fell upon them
entries.14.22: तेन by him, चक्रेण with a discus, रणे in battle, विष्णुना इव as though by Vishnu, हतः struck, मारीचः Maricha, शैलात् from the mountain, क्षीणपुण्यः whose merit is spent, ग्रहः इव as a star, भूतले to the ground, पतितः fell
entries.14.23: सः निशाचरः that night ranger, मुहूर्तेन in a moment, ससञ्ज्ञः तु came to his senses, विश्रम्य having rested, तम् यक्षम् that yaksha, योधयामास fought, सः च and he, भग्नः broken, प्रदुद्रुवे fled away
entries.14.24: ततः then, काञ्चनचित्राङ्गम् wonderful with gold, वैडूर्यरजसोक्षितम् sprinkled with the dust of beryl, प्रतिहाराणाम् of the doorkeepers, मर्यादाम् the boundary, तोरणान्तरम् the archway between the gates, आविशत् entered
entries.14.25: राजन् king, प्रविशन्तम् as he entered, तम् दशग्रीवम् that Dashagriva, निशाचरम् the night ranger, सूर्यभानुः इति as Suryabhanu, ख्यातः known, द्वारपालः a doorkeeper, न्यवारयत् barred
entries.14.26: यक्षेण by the yaksha, वार्यमाणः though barred, सः निशाचरः that night ranger, प्रविवेश pressed in, राम Rama, यदा तु when, वारितः barred, सः राक्षसः that rakshasa, न व्यतिष्ठत् would not stand still
entries.14.27: ततः then, तेन यक्षेण by that yaksha, तोरणम् the archway, उत्पाट्य having torn up, ताडितः being struck, रुधिरम् blood, प्रस्रवन् streaming, धातुस्रवैः with running ores, शैलः इव as a mountain, भाति shone
entries.14.28: सः वीरः that hero, शैलशिखराभेण like a mountain peak, तोरणेन by the archway, समाहतः struck, स्वयम्भुवः of the Self born, वरदानात् by the granting of the boon, क्षतिम् hurt, न जाम took none
entries.14.29: अथ then, तेन एव तोरणेन with that very archway, तेन by him, यक्षः the yaksha, अभिताडितः being struck, तदा then, भस्मीकृततनुः his body reduced to ashes, यक्षः the yaksha, तदा then, न अदृश्यत was seen no more
entries.14.30: ततः then, रक्षःपराक्रमम् the rakshasa's might, दृष्ट्वा having seen, सर्वे all, प्रदुद्रुवुः fled, ततः then, भयपीडिताः afflicted with fear, नदीः the rivers, गुहाः च एव and the caves, विविशुः entered, त्यक्तप्रहरणाः having cast away their weapons, श्रान्ताः worn out, तदा then, विवर्णवदनाः pale of face
entries.15.1: ततः then, वित्रस्तान् terrified, सहस्रशः by thousands, तान् यक्षेन्द्रान् च those lords of yakshas, लक्ष्य having seen, धनाध्यक्षः the lord of wealth, महायक्षम् the great yaksha, माणिचारम् Manichara, अथ then, अब्रवीत् said
entries.15.2: यक्षेन्द्र lord of yakshas, दुर्वृत्तम् ill conducted, पापचेतसम् of sinful mind, रावणम् Ravana, जहि slay, युद्धशालिनाम् who fight well, वीराणाम् of the brave, यक्षाणाम् yakshas, शरणम् the refuge, भव be
entries.15.3: एवम् thus, उक्तः being addressed, महाबाहुः the mighty armed, माणिभद्रः Manibhadra, सुदुर्जयः hard to conquer, चतुर्भिः by four, यक्षसहस्रैः तु by thousands of yakshas, वृतः surrounded, समयोधयत् fought
entries.15.4: तदा then, ते यक्षाः those yakshas, गदामुसलप्रासैः with maces and pestles and darts, शक्तितोमरमुद्गरैः with spears and javelins and clubs, अभिघ्नन्तः striking, राक्षसान् the rakshasas, समुपाद्रवन् rushed upon
entries.15.5: तुमुलम् tumultuous, युद्धम् battle, कुर्वन्तः making, श्येनवत् like hawks, लघु swiftly, चरन्तः moving, बाढम् strike hard, प्रयच्छ give way, न इच्छामि I want none of it, दीयताम् इति let it be given, भाषिणः crying
entries.15.6: ततः then, सगन्धर्वाः with the gandharvas, देवाः the gods, ब्रह्मवादिनः who speak of Brahman, ऋषयः the sages, तत् तुमुलम् युद्धम् that tumultuous battle, दृष्ट्वा having seen, परम् विस्मयम् the greatest wonder, आगमन् came to
entries.15.7: रणे in battle, प्रहस्तेन by Prahasta, यक्षाणाम् तु of the yakshas, सहस्रम् a thousand, निहतम् was slain, अनिन्द्यम् peerless, महोदरेण च and by Mahodara, अपरम् सहस्रम् another thousand, हतम् was struck down
entries.15.8: राजन् king, तदा then, क्रुद्धेन enraged, युयुत्सुना eager for the fight, मारीचेन by Maricha, निमेषान्तरमात्रेण in the space of a moment, द्वे सहस्रे two thousand, निपातिते were felled
entries.15.9: पुरुषव्याघ्र tiger among men, यक्षार्जवम् the yakshas' straightforward, युद्धम् fighting, क्व च where indeed, रक्षसाम् of the rakshasas, मायाबलाश्रयम् reliance on the strength of illusion, क्व च where, तेन by that, ते they, युधि in the fight, अभ्यधिकाः were the stronger
entries.15.10: महारणे in the great battle, धूम्राक्षेण with Dhumraksha, समागम्य having met, माणिभद्रः Manibhadra, क्रोधात् in anger, मुसलेन with a pestle, उरसि upon the chest, ताडितः though struck, न च कम्पितः was not shaken
entries.15.11: ततः then, माणिभद्रेण by Manibhadra, गदाम् his mace, समाविध्य having whirled, राक्षसः the rakshasa, धूम्राक्षः Dhumraksha, मूर्ध्नि upon the head, ताडितः being struck, सः he, विह्वलः reeling, पपात ह fell
entries.15.12: ताडितम् struck, पतितम् fallen, शोणितोक्षितम् drenched in blood, धूम्राक्षम् Dhumraksha, दृष्ट्वा having seen, दशाननः Dashanana, सङ्ग्रामे in the fight, माणिभद्रम् Manibhadra, अभ्यधावत rushed upon
entries.15.13: क्रुद्धम् in fury, अभिधावन्तम् rushing on, तम् दशाननम् that Dashanana, यक्षपुङ्गवः that bull among yakshas, माणिभद्रः Manibhadra, तिसृभिः with three, शक्तिभिः with spears, ताडयामास struck
entries.15.14: ताडितः being struck, रणे in battle, माणिभद्रस्य of Manibhadra, मुकुटे upon the crown, प्राहरत् he struck, तस्य his, तेन प्रहारेण by that blow, मुकुटम् the crown, पार्श्वम् to one side, आगतम् came
entries.15.15: ततः then, संयुध्यमानेन as he fought on, विष्टब्धः standing firm, न व्यकम्पत he did not waver, तदाप्रभृति from that day, असौ यक्षः that yaksha, पार्श्वमौलिः इति as He of the sideways crown, स्मृतः is remembered, राजन् king, तस्मिन् शैले upon that mountain, सुमहान् a great, सन्नादः roar, अभ्यवर्तत arose
entries.15.16: ततः then, गदाधरः bearing his mace, धनाध्यक्षः the lord of wealth, शुक्रप्रौष्ठपदाभ्याम् च with Shukra and Proshthapada, पद्मशङ्खसमावृतः surrounded by Padma and Shankha, दूरात् from afar, प्रददृशे was seen
entries.15.17: सः he, सङ्ख्ये in that battle, शापात् through a curse, विभ्रष्टगौरवम् fallen from honour, भ्रातरम् his brother, दृष्ट्वा having seen, धीमान् that wise one, पैतामहे कुले in the family of the Grandsire, युक्तम् worthy, वचनम् a word, उवाच said
entries.15.18: दुर्मते evil minded one, मया by me, वार्यमाणः when restrained, यत् that, त्वम् you, न अवगच्छसि did not understand, पश्चात् afterwards, अस्य of it, फलम् the fruit, प्राप्य having got, निरयम् to hell, गतः having gone, ज्ञास्यसे you will know
entries.15.19: यः हि whoever, दुर्मतिः the fool, मोहात् in delusion, विषम् poison, पीत्वा having drunk, न अवगच्छति does not understand, सः he, तस्य कर्मणः of that deed, परिणामान्ते at its ripening, फलम् the fruit, जानीते comes to know
entries.15.20: देवताः the gods, केनचित् by anything at all, धर्मयुक्तेन joined with dharma, न अभिनन्दन्ति take no delight, येन by which, त्वम् you, ईदृशम् भावम् such a state, नीतः सन् having been brought to, न अवबुद्ध्यसे do not understand
entries.15.21: यः हि whoever, मातरम् his mother, पितरम् his father, आचार्यम् च and his teacher, अवमन्यते slights, सः he, प्रेतराजवशम् under the sway of the king of the dead, गतः having gone, तस्य of it, फलम् the fruit, पश्यति sees
entries.15.22: यः who, अध्रुवे unsure, शरीरे in the body, तपोर्जनम् the earning of merit by penance, न करोति हि does not do, सः मूढः that fool, मृतः dead, आत्मनः his own, गतिम् condition, दृष्ट्वा having seen, पश्चात् afterwards, तप्यते repents
entries.15.23: धर्मात् from dharma, राज्यम् kingdom, धनम् wealth, सौख्यम् happiness, अधर्मात् from adharma, दुःखम् एव च and only sorrow, तस्मात् therefore, सुखार्थाय for his happiness, धर्मम् dharma, कुर्यात् let a man practise, पापम् sin, विसर्जयेत् let him cast off
entries.15.24: पापस्य हि of sin, फलम् the fruit, दुःखम् is sorrow, तत् that, इह here, आत्मना by oneself, भोक्तव्यम् must be borne, तस्मात् therefore, आत्मापघातार्थम् for his own destruction, मूढः a fool, पापम् sin, करिष्यति will do
entries.15.25: कस्यचित् for anyone, दुर्बुद्धेः of evil mind, मतिः right understanding, छन्दतः at will, न हि जायते does not arise, दैवम् fate, सर्वम् everything, चेष्टयते moves, दैवेन by fate, हतः the one struck down, हन्यते is struck, यादृशम् of what kind, कर्म a deed, कुरुते he does, तादृशम् of that kind, फलम् the fruit, अश्नुते he receives
entries.15.26: नराः men, लोके in the world, पुण्यकर्मभिः by meritorious deeds, निर्जितम् gained, बुद्धिम् wisdom, रूपम् beauty, फलम् fruit, पुत्रान् sons, शौर्यम् courage, धीरत्वम् एव च and steadfastness, प्राप्नुवन्ति win
entries.15.27: एवम् thus, यस्य ते whose, मतिः mind, ईदृशी is such, त्वम् you, निरयगामी are bound for hell, त्वाम् with you, न समभिभाषिष्ये I shall speak no more, असद्वृत्तेषु एव with those of evil conduct, निर्णयः the matter is settled
entries.15.28: ततः then, तेन by him, एवम् thus, उक्ताः being addressed, तस्य his, मारीचप्रमुखाः Maricha and the rest, सर्वे all, अमात्याः the ministers, समाहताः struck, विमुखाः with faces turned, विप्रदुद्रुवुः fled away
entries.15.29: ततः then, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva, महात्मना by that great souled, तेन यक्षेन्द्रेण by that lord of yakshas, गदया with a mace, मूर्ध्नि upon the head, अभिहतः being struck, स्थानात् from his place, न च प्रकम्पितः was not shaken
entries.15.30: राम Rama, ततः then, महामृधे in that great battle, तदा then, अन्योन्यम् one another, निघ्नन्तौ striking, अमर्षणौ full of wrath, तौ those two, न विह्वलौ neither grew faint, न च श्रान्तौ nor weary, बभूवतुः were
entries.15.31: तदा then, सः धनदः that giver of wealth, तस्मै at him, आग्नेयम् अस्त्रम् the fire weapon, मुमोच loosed, राक्षसेन्द्रः the lord of rakshasas, वारुणेन with the weapon of Varuna, तत् अस्त्रम् that weapon, प्रत्यवारयत् turned back
entries.15.32: ततः then, असौ राक्षसेश्वरः that lord of rakshasas, राक्षसीम् of the rakshasas, मायाम् the illusion, प्रविष्टः entered, विनाशाय for his enemy's destruction, रूपाणाम् of forms, शतसाहस्रम् a hundred thousand, चकार च made
entries.15.33: सः दशाननः that Dashanana, व्याघ्रः a tiger, वराहः a boar, जीमूतः a cloud, पर्वतः a mountain, सागरः an ocean, द्रुमः a tree, यक्षः a yaksha, दैत्यस्वरूपी च and in the shape of a daitya, अदृश्यत appeared
entries.15.34: बहूनि many, करोति स्म च he made, ततः thereafter, असौ he himself, न तु दृश्यन्ते was not to be seen, ततः then, राम Rama, दशाननः Dashanana, महत् mighty, अस्त्रम् a weapon, प्रतिगृह्य having taken up
entries.15.35: महतीम् great, गदाम् his mace, व्याविद्ध्य having whirled, मूर्ध्नि upon the head, धनदम् the giver of wealth, जघान struck, एवम् thus, तेन by him, अभिहतः struck, सः he, विह्वलः reeling, शोणितोक्षितः drenched in blood
entries.15.36: धनाधिपः the lord of wealth, कृत्तमूलः cut off at the root, अशोकः इव as an ashoka tree, निपपात fell
entries.15.37: ततः then, तत्र there, पद्मादिभिः by Padma and the rest, निधिभिः by the Treasures, सः he, तदा then, वृतः was surrounded, तैः तु by them, धनदः the giver of wealth, उच्छ्वासितः being revived, नन्दनम् वनम् the Nandana grove, आनीय being carried
entries.15.38: राक्षसेन्द्रः the lord of rakshasas, तम् धनदम् that giver of wealth, निर्जित्य having conquered, हृष्टमानसः with a glad heart, जयलक्षणम् the mark of victory, तस्य his, पुष्पकम् विमानम् the chariot Pushpaka, जग्राह took
entries.15.39: काञ्चनस्तम्भसंवीतम् girt with pillars of gold, वैडूर्यमणितोरणम् with archways of beryl and jewels, मुक्ताजालप्रतिच्छन्नम् hung about with nets of pearl, सर्वकामफलद्रुमम् bearing trees that yield every desire
entries.15.40: मनोजवम् swift as thought, कामगमम् going where it is wished, कामरूपम् taking what shape is wished, विहङ्गमम् moving through the sky, मणिकाञ्चनसोपानम् with steps of jewels and gold, तप्तकाञ्चनवेदिकम् with terraces of refined gold
entries.15.41: देवोपवाह्यम् borne by the gods, अक्षय्यम् imperishable, सदादृष्टिमनःसुखम् always a joy to the eye and the mind, बह्वाश्चर्यम् full of marvels, भक्तिचित्रम् wonderful in its craftsmanship, ब्रह्मणा by Brahma, परिनिर्मितम् fashioned
entries.15.42: सर्वकामैः तु with all delights, निर्मितम् made, मनोहरम् most lovely, अनुत्तमम् beyond compare, न तु शीतम् neither cold, न च उष्णम् nor hot, सर्वर्तुसुखदम् giving ease in every season, शुभम् auspicious
entries.15.43: सः राजा that king, वीर्यनिर्जितम् won by his valour, कामगम् going where it is wished, तम् it, समारुह्य having mounted, दर्पोत्सेकात् in the arrogance of his pride, सुदुर्मतिः that evil minded one, त्रिभुवनम् the three worlds, जितम् conquered, मेने thought
entries.15.44: देवम् the god, वैश्रवणम् Vaishravana, जित्वा having conquered, कैलासात् from Kailasa, समवातरत् he came down
entries.15.45: प्रतापवान् the mighty, निशाचरः night ranger, स्वतेजसा by his own splendour, विपुलम् great, तम् जयम् that victory, अवाप्य having won, विमलकिरीटहारवान् wearing a spotless diadem and necklaces, परमविमानम् in that finest of chariots, आस्थितः seated, सदसि in an assembly, गतः come, अनलः यथा as fire, रराज वै shone
entries.16.1: राम Rama, सः राक्षसाधिपः that lord of rakshasas, भ्रातरम् his brother, धनदम् the giver of wealth, जित्वा having conquered, महासेनप्रसूतिम् where Mahasena was born, तत् महत् that great, शरवणम् reed thicket, ययौ went to
entries.16.2: अथ then, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva, गभस्तिजालसंवीतम् wrapped in a web of rays, द्वितीयम् a second, भास्करम् इव like the sun, रौक्मम् golden, महत् great, शरवणम् reed thicket, अपश्यत् saw
entries.16.3: सः he, रम्यवनान्तरम् with lovely woodland glades, कञ्चित् a certain, पर्वतम् mountain, समारुह्य having climbed, तदा then, तत्र there, विष्टम्भितम् held fast, पुष्पकम् the Pushpaka, अपश्यत् saw
entries.16.4: कामगम् going where it is wished, अगमम् unable to move, कृतम् made, पुष्पकम् the Pushpaka, विष्टब्धम् halted, दृष्ट्वा having seen, तैः सचिवैः by those ministers, समावृतः surrounded, राक्षसेन्द्रः the lord of rakshasas, अचिन्तयत् considered
entries.16.5: इदम् पुष्पकम् this Pushpaka, मे my, इच्छया at my will, किन्निमित्तम् for what reason, न गच्छति does not go, पर्वतस्य of the mountain, उपरिष्ठस्य of one who stands upon, कस्यचित् of someone, इदम् कर्म this deed, भवेत् can it be
entries.16.6: ततः then, राम Rama, तदा then, बुद्धिकोविदः skilled in judgement, मारीचः Maricha, अब्रवीत् said, राजन् king, यत् that, इदम् पुष्पकम् this Pushpaka, न गच्छति does not go, निष्कारणम् न not without cause
entries.16.7: अथवा or else, इदम् पुष्पकम् this Pushpaka, धनदात् of the giver of wealth, न अन्यवाहनम् is the vehicle of no other, अतः therefore, धनाध्यक्षविनाकृतम् parted from the lord of wealth, निष्पन्दम् motionless, अभवत् it has become
entries.16.8: इति वाक्यान्तरे while these words were passing, तस्य his, करालः grim, कृष्णपिङ्गलः dark and tawny, वामनः dwarfish, विकटः misshapen, मुण्डी shaven headed, प्रह्वभुजः with drooping arms, बली mighty, नन्दी Nandi
entries.16.9: ततः then, भवस्य of Bhava, अनुचरः the attendant, नन्दीश्वरः Nandishvara, पार्श्वम् to his side, उपागम्य having come, अशङ्कितः without fear, राक्षसेन्द्रम् to the lord of rakshasas, इदम् वचः this word, अब्रवीत् said
entries.16.10: दशग्रीव Dashagriva, निवर्तस्व turn back, शैले upon the mountain, शङ्करः Shankara, क्रीडति sports, सुपर्णनागयक्षाणाम् for suparnas and nagas and yakshas, देवगन्धर्वरक्षसाम् for gods and gandharvas and rakshasas
entries.16.11: सर्वेषाम् एव for all, भूतानाम् beings, पर्वतः the mountain, अगम्यः impassable, कृतः has been made, इति thus, नन्दिवचः Nandi's word, श्रुत्वा having heard, क्रोधात् with anger, कम्पितकुण्डलः his earrings shaking
entries.16.12: रोषात् तु with fury, ताम्रनयनः his eyes red, सः he, पुष्पकात् from the Pushpaka, अवरुह्य having come down, अयम् शङ्करः this Shankara, कः who is, इति thus, उक्त्वा having said, शैलमूलम् to the foot of the mountain, उपागतः came
entries.16.13: सः he, तत्र there, देवस्य of the god, अदूरतः not far, स्थितम् standing, दीप्तम् blazing, शूलम् his trident, अवष्टभ्य leaning upon, द्वितीयम् a second, शङ्करम् इव like Shankara, नन्दिनम् Nandin, अपश्यत् saw
entries.16.14: सः राक्षसः that rakshasa, वानरमुखम् his monkey face, तम् him, दृष्ट्वा having seen, अवज्ञाय scorning, तत्र there, सतोयः full of rain, तोयदः इव as a cloud, प्रहासम् loud laughter, मुमुचे let loose
entries.16.15: तत्र there, क्रुद्धः angered, भगवान् नन्दी the lord Nandi, शङ्करस्य of Shankara, अपरा तनुः another body, उपस्थितम् who stood before him, तत् दशाननम् रक्षः that rakshasa Dashanana, अब्रवीत् said to
entries.16.16: दशानन Dashanana, यस्मात् since, वानररूपम् of monkey shape, माम् me, अवज्ञाय having scorned, अशनीपातसङ्काशम् like the fall of a thunderbolt, अपहासम् a laugh, प्रमुक्तवान् you let loose
entries.16.17: तस्मात् therefore, मद्रूपसम्पन्नाः endowed with my shape, मद्वीर्यसमतेजसः equal to me in valour and splendour, तव your, कुलस्य of your line, वधार्थम् हि for the destruction, वानराः monkeys, उत्पत्स्यन्ति shall be born
entries.16.18: नखदंष्ट्रायुधाः whose weapons are claws and teeth, क्रूराः cruel, मनःसम्पातरंहसः swift as thought, युद्धोन्मत्ताः wild in battle, बलोद्रिक्ताः swollen with strength, विसर्पिणः ranging, शैलाः इव as mountains
entries.16.19: ते they, सम्भूय having come together, सहामात्यसुतस्य च with your ministers and sons, तव your, प्रबलम् great, दर्पम् pride, पृथग्विधम् of every kind, उत्सेधम् च and arrogance, व्यपनेष्यन्ति shall take away
entries.16.20: हे निशाचर night ranger, किम् तु but what, इदानीम् now, मया by me, त्वाम् you, हन्तुम् to slay, शक्यम् would be of use, हतः slain, त्वम् you, पूर्वम् एव already, स्वकर्मभिः हि by your own deeds, न हन्तव्यः are not to be slain
entries.16.21: इति thus, महात्मनि that great souled, तस्मिन् देवे when the god, उदीरितवाक्ये had uttered his word, देवदुन्दुभयः the drums of the gods, नेदुः sounded, खात् from the sky, च्युता fallen, पुष्पवृष्टिः च and a rain of flowers
entries.16.22: महाबलः that mighty one, दशाननः Dashanana, तदा then, नन्दिवाक्यम् Nandi's word, अचिन्तयित्वा giving no thought to, पर्वतम् तु the mountain, समासाद्य having come to, वाक्यम् a word, आह said
entries.16.23: गोपते lord of cattle, गच्छतः as I travelled, मम my, यत्कृते for which, पुष्पकस्य of the Pushpaka, गतिः the course, छिन्ना has been broken, तव your, तम् इमम् शैलम् this very mountain, उन्मूलम् uprooted, करोमि I shall make
entries.16.24: केन प्रभावेण by what power, भवः Bhava, नित्यम् always, राजवत् like a king, क्रीडति sports here, विज्ञातव्यम् what ought to be known, न जानीते he does not know, भयस्थानम् a cause of fear, उपस्थितम् stands before him
entries.16.25: राम Rama, एवम् thus, उक्त्वा having spoken, ततः then, पर्वते beneath the mountain, भुजान् his arms, विक्षिप्य having thrust, शीघ्रम् swiftly, तम् it, तोलयामास he heaved at, सः शैलः that mountain, समकम्पत shook
entries.16.26: पर्वतस्य of the mountain, चालनात् एव at the shaking, देवस्य of the god, गणाः the attendants, कम्पिताः were thrown about, तदा then, पार्वती Parvati, च अपि too, चचाल shook, महेश्वरम् Maheshvara, आश्लिष्टा clung to
entries.16.27: ततः then, राम Rama, महादेवः the great god, देवानाम् प्रवरः best of the gods, हरः Hara, तम् शैलम् that mountain, पादाङ्गुष्ठेन with the tip of his toe, लीलया in play, पीडयामास pressed down
entries.16.28: ततः then, तस्य his, भुजाः arms, शैलस्य of the mountain, अधोगताः caught beneath, पीडिताः तु were pressed, तत्र there, तस्य रक्षसः of that rakshasa, सचिवाः the ministers, विस्मिताः amazed, अभवन् च stood
entries.16.29: तदा then, तेन रक्षसा by that rakshasa, रोषात् च in fury, भुजानाम् of his arms, पीडनात् at the crushing, सहसा suddenly, विरावः a cry, मुक्तः was let loose, येन by which, त्रैलोक्यम् the three worlds, कम्पितम् were shaken
entries.16.30: तस्य his, अमात्याः counsellors, युगक्षये at the ending of an age, वज्रनिष्पेषम् the crash of the thunderbolt, मेनिरे took it for, तदा then, इन्द्रपुरोगमाः with Indra at their head, देवाः the gods, वर्त्मस्थचलिताः were moved from their courses
entries.16.31: समुद्राः the oceans, सङ्क्षुब्धाः च अपि were troubled, पर्वताः the mountains, चलिताः च अपि and shook, यक्षाः yakshas, विद्याधराः vidyadharas, सिद्धाः siddhas, किम् एतत् what is this, इति thus, च अब्रुवन् said
entries.16.32: अथ then, तस्य his, ते मन्त्रिणः those ministers, विक्रोशन्तम् as he cried out, अथ then, अब्रुवन् said, महादेवम् the great god, नीलकण्ठम् the blue throated, उमापतिम् the lord of Uma, तोषयस्व propitiate
entries.16.33: दशानन Dashanana, अत्र here, तम् ऋते but him, अन्यम् another, शरणम् refuge, न पश्यामः we see not, स्तुतिभिः with hymns of praise, प्रणतः bowed low, भूत्वा having become, तम् एव him alone, शरणम् for refuge, व्रज go to
entries.16.34: शङ्करः Shankara, कृपालुः compassionate, तुष्टः being pleased, ते to you, प्रसादम् favour, विधास्यति will show, तदा then, अमात्यैः by his ministers, एवम् thus, उक्तः being addressed, वृषभध्वजम् the bull bannered one, तुष्टाव he praised
entries.16.35: सः दशाननः that Dashanana, विविधैः of many kinds, सामभिः with the chants of the Saman, स्तोत्रैः with hymns, प्रणम्य having bowed low, रुदतः as he wept, रक्षसः of the rakshasa, संवत्सरसहस्रम् तु a thousand years, गतम् passed
entries.16.36: ततः then, महादेवः the great god, प्रीतः pleased, प्रभुः the lord, शैलाग्रे upon the mountain top, विष्ठितः standing, राम Rama, अस्य his, भुजान् arms, मुक्त्वा च having released, दशाननम् to Dashanana, वाक्यम् a word, प्राह said
entries.16.37: दशानन Dashanana, तव your, वीर्यस्य valour, शौण्डार्यात् च and daring, प्रीतः अस्मि I am pleased, शैलाक्रान्तेन crushed beneath the mountain, त्वया by you, यः सुदारुणः so terrible, रावः a cry, मुक्तः was let loose
entries.16.38: यस्मात् since, एतत् लोकत्रयम् these three worlds, रावितम् were made to cry out, भयम् fear, आगतम् came, तस्मात् therefore, राजन् king, त्वम् you, नाम्ना by name, रावणः नाम by the name Ravana, भविष्यसि shall be
entries.16.39: देवताः gods, मानुषाः men, यक्षाः yakshas, ये च अन्ये and whatever others, जगतीतले upon the face of the earth, एवम् thus, त्वाम् you, लोकरावणम् who makes the worlds cry out, रावणम् Ravana, अभिधास्यन्ति shall call
entries.16.40: पौलस्त्य son of Pulastya, त्वम् you, येन पथा by whatever road, इच्छसि you please, विस्रब्धम् in confidence, गच्छ go, राक्षसाधिप lord of rakshasas, मया च एव by me indeed, अभ्यनुज्ञातः given leave, गम्यताम् let it be gone
entries.16.41: एवम् thus, शम्भुना by Shambhu, उक्तः being addressed, लङ्केशः the lord of Lanka, स्वयम् himself, अब्रवीत् said, महादेव great god, प्रीतः यदि if you are pleased, याचतः as I ask, मे to me, वरम् a boon, देहि grant
entries.16.42: देवगन्धर्वदानवैः by gods and gandharvas and danavas, राक्षसैः by rakshasas, गुह्यकैः by guhyakas, नागैः by nagas, ये च अन्ये and whatever others, बलवत्तराः of great strength, अवध्यत्वम् the state of not being slain, मया by me, प्राप्तम् has been obtained
entries.16.43: देव god, मानुषान् men, न गणे I do not count, ते they, मम to me, स्वल्पाः of small account, सम्मताः are held, त्रिपुरान्तक destroyer of the three cities, ब्रह्मणः from Brahma, दीर्घम् long, आयुः च and life, मे by me, प्राप्तम् has been obtained
entries.16.44: वाञ्छितम् as I desire, आयुषः of my life, शेषम् the remainder, शस्त्रम् च and a weapon, त्वम् you, मे to me, प्रयच्छ grant, ततः then, तेन रावणेन by that Ravana, एवम् thus, उक्तः being addressed, सः शङ्करः that Shankara
entries.16.45: चन्द्रहासम् इति as Chandrahasa, श्रुतम् renowned, महादीप्तम् greatly blazing, खड्गम् a sword, ददौ gave, आयुषः of his life, अवशेषम् च and the remainder, तदा then, भूतपतिः the lord of beings, स्थित्वा standing
entries.16.46: दत्त्वा having given, ततः then, शम्भुः Shambhu, उवाच said, इदम् this, त्वया by you, न अवज्ञेयम् is not to be treated with contempt, ते by you, अवज्ञातम् यदि हि if it is contemned, माम् एव to me alone, एष्यति it will come, असंशयः there is no doubt
entries.16.47: एवम् thus, महेश्वरेण एव by Maheshvara himself, कृतनामा named, सः रावणः that Ravana, महादेवम् the great god, अभिवाद्य having saluted, अथ then, पुष्पकम् the Pushpaka, आरुरोह mounted
entries.16.48: ततः then, राम Rama, रावणः Ravana, महीतले upon the face of the earth, इतस्ततः here and there, सुमहावीर्यान् of great valour, क्षत्रियान् kshatriyas, बाधमानः harrying, पर्यक्रामत ranged
entries.16.49: केचित् some, तेजस्विनः splendid, शूराः brave, युद्धदुर्मदाः mad for battle, क्षत्रियाः kshatriyas, तत् शासनम् his bidding, अकुर्वन्तः not doing, सपरिच्छदाः with all that belonged to them, विनेशुः perished
entries.16.50: अपरे others, प्राज्ञसम्मताः esteemed as wise, दुर्जयम् hard to conquer, रक्षः the rakshasa, जानन्तः knowing, बलदर्पितम् in his pride of strength, राक्षसम् to the rakshasa, जिताः स्म we are conquered, इति thus, अभाषन्त said
entries.17.1: अथ then, राजन् king, महाबाहुः that mighty armed one, सः रावणः that Ravana, महीतले upon the face of the earth, विचरन् ranging, हिमवद्वनम् the forest of Himavat, आसाद्य having come to, परिचक्राम wandered
entries.17.2: तत्र there, सः he, कृष्णाजिनजटाधराम् wearing a black deerskin and matted hair, आर्षेण विधिना with the discipline of the sages, युक्ताम् following, देवताम् इव like a goddess, दीप्यन्तीम् blazing, कन्याम् वै a maiden, अपश्यत् saw
entries.17.3: सः he, रूपसम्पन्नाम् endowed with beauty, सुमहाव्रताम् holding a great vow, ताम् कन्याम् that maiden, दृष्ट्वा having seen, काममोहपरीतात्मा his soul overcome by the confusion of desire, प्रहसन् इव as though laughing, पप्रच्छ asked
entries.17.4: भद्रे good lady, ते your, यौवनस्य to your youth, विरुद्धम् against, इदम् this, किम् वर्तसे why do you live so, तव your, एतस्य रूपस्य of such beauty, एषा प्रतिक्रिया this treatment, न हि युक्ता is not fitting
entries.17.5: भीरु timid one, ते your, रूपम् beauty, अनुपमम् beyond compare, नृणाम् for men, कामोन्मादकरम् maddening with desire, तपसि in penance, स्थातुम् to stand, न युक्तम् is not fitting, एषः this, निर्णयः हि is my judgement
entries.17.6: भद्रे good lady, कस्य whose, असि are you, इदम् this, किम् what is it, वरानने fair faced one, भर्ता your husband, कः च and who, भीरु timid one, येन by whom, सम्भुज्यसे you are enjoyed, सः नरः that man, भुवि in this world, पुण्यभाक् has good fortune
entries.17.7: पृच्छतः as I ask, मे to me, सर्वम् all, शंस tell, कस्य हेतोः for what cause, परिश्रमः this labour, एवम् thus, रावणेन by Ravana, उक्ता being addressed, सा यशस्विनी that glorious, कन्या तु maiden
entries.17.8: मम my, पिता father, ब्रह्मर्षिः a brahmarshi, अमितप्रभः of measureless splendour, श्रीमान् the glorious, बृहस्पतिसुतः son of Brihaspati, बुद्ध्या in understanding, बृहस्पतेः to Brihaspati, तुल्यः the equal, कुशध्वजः Kushadhvaja
entries.17.9: नित्यम् always, वेदाभ्यासम् the recitation of the Veda, कुर्वतः as he was engaged in, तस्य महात्मनः of that great soul, अहम् I, वाङ्मयी formed of speech, कन्या a maiden, सम्भूय came into being, नाम्ना by name, वेदवती Vedavati, स्मृता am remembered
entries.17.10: ततः then, सगन्धर्वाः with the gandharvas, देवाः the gods, यक्षराक्षसपन्नगाः yakshas and rakshasas and serpents, ते अपि they too, पितरम् to my father, गत्वा हि having gone, मे of me, वरणम् the choosing, रोचयन्ति were eager for
entries.17.11: राक्षसर्षभ bull among rakshasas, सः पिता that father, तेभ्यः to them, माम् me, न च दत्तवान् did not give, निशाचर night ranger, तत् कारणम् that reason, वदिष्यामि I shall tell, निशामय hear
entries.17.12: मम my, पितुः तु of my father, सुरेश्वरः the lord of the gods, विष्णुः Vishnu, त्रिलोकेशः master of the three worlds, जामाता son in law, किल indeed, अभिप्रेतः was chosen, तस्मात् therefore, मे my, पिता father, अन्यस्य to another, न ददौ did not give
entries.17.13: तस्मै to him, दातुम् to give, इच्छति he wished, तत् that, श्रुत्वा तु having heard, बलदर्पितः proud of his strength, दैत्यानाम् of the daityas, राजा the king, शम्भुः नाम named Shambhu, ततः then, कुपितः अभवत् grew wroth
entries.17.14: तेन पापेन by that sinful one, रात्रौ at night, शयानः as he slept, मे my, पिता father, हिंसितः was killed
entries.17.15: ततः then, मे my, जननी mother, दीना wretched, महाभागा greatly blessed, मम my, पितुः of my father, तत् शरीरम् that body, परिष्वज्य having embraced, हव्यवाहनम् the fire, प्रविष्टा entered
entries.17.16: ततः then, अहम् I, नारायणम् प्रति concerning Narayana, पितुः of my father, मनोरथम् the wish, सत्यम् true, करोमि इति to make, तम् एव him alone, हृदयेन in my heart, समुद्वहे I bear
entries.17.17: इति thus, प्रतिज्ञाम् a vow, आरुह्य having taken up, विपुलम् great, तपः penance, चरामि I practise, राक्षसपुङ्गव bull among rakshasas, एतत् this, सर्वम् all, मया by me, ते to you, आख्यातम् has been told
entries.17.18: नारायणः Narayana, मम my, पतिः husband, पुरुषोत्तमात् than the best of beings, अन्यः another, न तु is not, नारायणपरीप्सया out of longing for Narayana, घोरम् dreadful, नियमम् an observance, आश्रये I keep, राजन् king, त्वम् you, मे by me, विज्ञातः हि are known indeed, पौलस्त्यनन्दन son of Pulastya's line, गच्छ go
entries.17.19: तपसा by penance, त्रैलोक्ये in the three worlds, यत् हि वर्तते whatever passes, सर्वम् all, जानामि I know
entries.17.20: सः रावणः that Ravana, कन्दर्पशरपीडितः pierced by the arrows of Kandarpa, विमानाग्रात् from his chariot, अवरुह्य having come down, सुमहाव्रताम् of the great vow, ताम् कन्याम् to that maiden, भूयः again, अब्रवीत् said
entries.17.21: सुश्रोणि fair one, यस्याः ते whose, मतिः mind, ईदृशी is such, अवलिप्ता असि you are full of pride, मृगशावाक्षि doe eyed one, वृद्धानाम् in the aged, पुण्यसञ्चयः a store of merit, भ्राजते shines
entries.17.22: त्वम् you, सर्वगुणसम्पन्ना endowed with every virtue, ईदृशम् in such a way, वक्तुम् to speak, न अर्हसे should not, भीरु timid one, त्रैलोक्यसुन्दरी beauty of the three worlds, ते your, यौवनम् youth, निवर्तते is passing
entries.17.23: भद्रे good lady, अहम् I, लङ्कापतिः lord of Lanka, दशग्रीवः इति as Dashagriva, श्रुतः am known, तस्य मे of me, भार्या wife, त्वम् you, भव be, भोगान् pleasures, यथासुखम् at your ease, भुङ्क्ष्व enjoy
entries.17.24: यम् whom, त्वम् you, विष्णुः इति as Vishnu, अभिभाषसे speak of, असौ he, कः च तावत् and who is he, वीर्येण in valour, तपसा by penance, च एव and, भोगेन by enjoyment, बलेन च and by strength
entries.17.25: भद्रे good lady, अङ्गने fair limbed one, यम् whom, त्वम् you, कामयसे desire, सः he, मया by me, समः न is not the equal
entries.17.26: तस्मिन् he, इति उक्तवति तु when he had spoken thus, अथ then, सा वेदवती that Vedavati, अब्रवीत् said
entries.17.27: सा कन्या that maiden, तम् निशाचरम् to that night ranger, मा मा एवम् इति do not do not speak so, उवाच said, त्रैलोक्याधिपतिम् master of the three worlds, सर्वलोकनमस्कृतम् to whom all the worlds bow, विष्णुम् Vishnu, राक्षसेन्द्र lord of rakshasas, त्वदृते but you, कः बुद्धिमान् what man of understanding, अवमन्येत would slight
entries.17.28: तया वेदवत्या by that Vedavati, तत्र there, एवम् thus, उक्तः being addressed, निशाचरः the night ranger, तदा then, कन्याम् the maiden, मूर्धजेषु by the hair, कराग्रेण with the tips of his fingers, परामृशत् seized
entries.17.29: ततः then, क्रुद्धा angered, सा वेदवती that Vedavati, हस्तेन with her hand, केशान् the hair, अच्छिनत् cut off, तस्याः her, करः hand, असिः a sword, भूत्वा having become, तदा then, केशान् the hair, छिन्नान् cut, अकरोत् made
entries.17.30: सा she, रोषेण with rage, ज्वलन्ती इव as though blazing, निशाचरम् the night ranger, दहन्ती इव as though burning up, अग्निम् a fire, समाधाय having kindled, मरणाय for death, कृतत्वरा hastening, उवाच said
entries.17.31: अनार्य base one, त्वया by you, धर्षितायाः having been outraged, मे to me, जीवितम् life, न इष्यते is not desired, रक्षः rakshasa, तस्मात् therefore, ते पश्यतः before your eyes, हुताशनम् the fire, प्रवेक्ष्यामि I shall enter
entries.17.32: यस्मात् तु since, त्वया by you, पापात्मना evil souled, वने in the forest, अहम् I, धर्षिता have been outraged, तस्मात् therefore, तव your, वधार्थम् हि for the destruction, अहम् I, पुनः again, समुत्पत्स्ये shall be born
entries.17.33: स्त्रिया by a woman, पापनिश्चयः whose purpose is sin, पुरुषः a man, हन्तुम् to slay, न हि शक्यम् is not possible, त्वयि upon you, शापे a curse, मया by me, उत्सृष्टे being loosed, तपसः of my penance, व्ययः च spending, भवेत् would be
entries.17.34: मया by me, किञ्चित् anything at all, कृतम् done, दत्तम् given, तथा and, हुतम् offered, यदि तु अस्ति if there is, तस्मात् by that, अयोनिजा born of no womb, साध्वी virtuous, धर्मिणः of a righteous man, सुता the daughter, भवेयम् may I be
entries.17.35: एवम् thus, उक्त्वा having spoken, सा she, ज्वलितम् blazing, जातवेदसम् the fire, प्रविष्टा entered, समन्ततः on every side, दिव्या divine, पुष्पवृष्टिः च and a rain of flowers, दिवः from the sky, पपात fell
entries.17.36: पद्मे in a lotus, पद्मसमप्रभा radiant as the lotus, पुनः एव again, समुद्भूता came into being, तस्मात् अपि from there too, तेन रक्षसा by that rakshasa, पूर्ववत् as before, पुनः again, प्राप्ता was taken
entries.17.37: कमलगर्भाभाम् bright as the heart of a lotus, कन्याम् the maiden, प्रगृह्य having taken, स्वगृहम् to his own house, ययौ went, प्रगृह्य having taken her, रावणः तु Ravana, एताम् her, मन्त्रिणे to his counsellor, दर्शयामास showed
entries.17.38: लक्षणज्ञः the knower of marks, निरीक्ष्य एव having looked at her, रावणम् to Ravana, एवम् thus, च अब्रवीत् said, एषा सुश्रोणी this fair one, गृहस्था हि if kept in the house, त्वद्वधाय एव for your destruction alone, दृश्यते is seen
entries.17.39: राम Rama, एतत् this, श्रुत्वा having heard, रावणः Ravana, ताम् her, अर्णवे into the ocean, प्रचिक्षेप cast, सा च एव and she, क्षितिम् the earth, आसाद्य having come to, यज्ञायतनमध्यगा came into the midst of a place of sacrifice
entries.17.40: राज्ञः of a king, हलमुखोत्कृष्टा turned up by the ploughshare, सती that virtuous one, पुनः अपि again, उत्थिता rose, प्रभो lord, सा एषा she is, जनकराजस्य of King Janaka, प्रसूता born, तनया the daughter, महाबाहो mighty armed one, तव your, भार्या wife, त्वम् हि you indeed, सनातनः the eternal, विष्णुः Vishnu
entries.17.41: पूर्वम् before, क्रोधाहितः laid low by anger, शत्रुः the enemy, यया by her, असौ he, तथा thus, निहतः was slain, तव your, अमानुषम् more than human, वीर्यम् valour, उपाश्रयित्वा having taken refuge in
entries.17.42: एवम् thus, एषा महाभागा that greatly blessed one, हलमुखोत्कृष्टे turned up by the ploughshare, क्षेत्रे in a field, वेद्याम् upon the altar, अग्निशिखोपमा like a tongue of flame, मर्त्येषु among mortals, पुनः again, उत्पत्स्यते is born
entries.17.43: एषा she, पूर्वम् formerly, कृते युगे in the Krita age, वेदवती नाम Vedavati by name, आसीत् was, त्रेतायुगम् the Treta age, अनुप्राप्य having come to, तस्य रक्षसः of that rakshasa, वधार्थम् for the destruction
entries.17.44: महात्मनः of the great souled, जनकस्य of Janaka, मैथिलकुले in the Maithila line, उत्पन्ना was born, सीता उत्पन्ना तु being born of the furrow, सीता इति as Sita, मानुषैः by men, पुनः thereafter, उच्यते is called
